How Write the World works

Writing community

A place for 13-19 year olds to share their writing, respond to prompts, and enter competitions for free – while receiving feedback from experts and peers.

Writing competitions

Teens write in various genres, gain recognition from notable guest judges, and win cash prizes.

Workshops

Teens further develop their writing skills through workshops and receive expert guidance on their college application essays.

Clara: Your AI Writing Companion

Clara poses Socratic questions that empower young writers to think more deeply about their learning and writing. Available within our writing community, and via pilots for schools and districts.

Support the mission

Our wider community includes educators, parents, volunteers, donors, and partners who work together to support teen voices around the world. Here’s how you can get involved:

Free Resources for Educators and Parents

Check out our library of free resources for teachers, parents, and homeschoolers. These resources include activity suggestions, comprehensive lesson plans, and exemplary mentor texts, all aimed at captivating teenagers in the writing journey and enhancing their skills

Volunteer to Right the World

Our amazing volunteers help provide a safe and supportive community, help young writers find their voice, and help improve our programs. All volunteer roles are virtual and many have flexible commitment expectations

Join Our Young Professionals Network

Many of our program alumni and other young professional writers (ages 19+) stay involved with free bimonthly writing workshops and networking opportunities

Partner to Support Young Voices

We partner with organizations committed to supporting writing education, literacy, global citizenship, and student success in academics, career and life. Get in touch to explore potential collaborations
